3. **The rail product cards** (dimensions, aspect ratio, gap between cards, how many show per breakpoint, image-only content per SFCC-83's own confirmed spec).
4. **The full layout** (overall rail container width/height per breakpoint, horizontal scroll/snap behaviour, edge-to-edge bleed on mobile/tablet — the container's own docblock claims this was "confirmed live on PDP/Cart/PLP, 2026-09-08" via real Playwright screenshots; re-verify this claim rather than trust it, since Marcel is reporting it looks off now).

A screenshot (`get_screenshot`) of the primary container nodes is worth taking too, for a visual sanity check alongside the numeric metrics.

## Report format

Report back a structured list, most-severe/most-confident first. For each finding: what Figma says (node ID + exact value/token), what the code currently does (file:line + exact value), and the concrete visual consequence. Separate CONFIRMED (you're certain, values directly conflict) from PLAUSIBLE (looks wrong but you couldn't fully verify — e.g., a token that doesn't resolve cleanly, or a breakpoint you couldn't confirm). State explicitly what you could NOT verify and why (e.g., rate-limited, node inaccessible, ambiguous which real breakpoint a Figma node represents). Do not fix anything — this is audit-only; Marcel and the coordinating session will decide what to fix. Keep the report itself tight — a table or short bulleted list per area, not prose essays per finding.

**Directive:** Audit the Recently Viewed Rail (header, see-full-history link, product cards, full layout) against Figma, across PLP/PDP/Cart, and report precise cited discrepancies — not vague "looks off."

## CONFIRMED

**1. Header row is missing horizontal padding entirely, at all three breakpoints.**
- Figma: Desktop header (`40000538:20306`, metadata-confirmed 1440×96) has `px-40px` (`alias/space/1000`) each side. Tablet (`40000730:13364`) and Mobile (`40000538:25031`) both have `px-32px` (`alias/space/800`) each side.
- Code: `zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts:131-139`, `header` style object has no `paddingInline`/`px` at all — the file's own docblock even flags this as unconfirmed ("zero horizontal padding... a judgment call, not a confirmed Figma reading" — lines 42-50).
- Consequence: title text and the See-Full-History link currently sit flush to the container's edges instead of inset 32-40px, at every breakpoint.

**2. Header content is vertically centered symmetrically; Figma's padding is asymmetric (top-heavy), not centered.**
- Figma Desktop: `pt-40px` / `pb-32px` around 24px content (40+24+32=96, confirmed via metadata height=96). Tablet/Mobile: `pt-20px` / `pb-12px` around 24px content (20+24+12=56, confirmed via metadata height=56 on Tablet).
- Code: `zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts:131-139`, `alignItems: 'center'` on a fixed-height flex row — centers the 24px content exactly at (96-24)/2=36px top/bottom on Desktop and (56-24)/2=16px top/bottom on Mobile/Tablet, not Figma's real 40/32 and 20/12 split.
- Consequence: title/link sit measurably lower than spec at every breakpoint (4px low on Desktop, 4px low on Mobile/Tablet) — small individually, but compounds with finding 1 (both are "header content position" bugs).

**3. Card width and aspect ratio are exactly right — not a discrepancy, stated for completeness.** Desktop 288×432 (metadata-confirmed), Tablet 256px width (metadata-confirmed) — both match `CARD_WIDTH_DESKTOP`/`CARD_WIDTH_TABLET` in `zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts:77-79` exactly. Card counts per breakpoint (2/3/5) also match the Tablet metadata's own 3 visible + 2 hidden extra instances.

## PLAUSIBLE (not fully verified — stated why)

**4. Desktop breakpoint may switch 256px too late.** Figma's own generated reference code carries `min-w-[1024px]` on the Desktop variant frame and `max-w-[1023px]` on the Tablet variant — implying Desktop-specific sizing (96px header, 40px padding, 288px cards) should start at 1024px. Current code's `DESKTOP_UP_QUERY` uses `breakpoints.xl` (`zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts:110`, documented as 1280px). If so, a 1024-1279px viewport shows Tablet dimensions when Figma wants Desktop ones. **Not independently confirmed** — this is inferred from a Tailwind hint class in the generated reference, not a raw Figma resize-constraint I could pull via `get_metadata` (that tool doesn't surface component-set variant-switching rules); would need checking the component set's own responsive/variant-switch config directly, which wasn't accessible with the tools used this pass.

**5. Tablet/Mobile card aspect ratio may be subtly off 2:3.** Tablet card measured 256×381.85 (metadata) = ratio 0.6705, vs. a clean 2:3 = 0.6667 — about a 0.5% difference (~1px over a 384px-tall card). Code (`zimmProductCardMedia`'s `slide` part) hardcodes `aspectRatio: '2/3'` at every breakpoint. Low confidence this is a deliberate design difference rather than a Figma authoring/scaling artifact — the delta is small enough that it could go either way; flagging rather than asserting.

## Could not verify at all

**6. The `40006591:*` node cluster (file 1) and the `9730:*` node ccluster (file 2)** — every ID tried from both (2 each) returned "node may have been deleted, or the ID was extracted incorrectly." Same failure signature as an already-known broken node family from earlier in this build (Open Question 11 in the build plan, `9086:9335`/`8802:10232`). Both clusters appear to be dead links in Marcel's list, not a source of new information — 12+ of the ~60 URLs given trace back to these two dead clusters.

**7. Live-rendered comparison** (actual PLP/PDP/Cart pages, or the "edge-to-edge bleed... confirmed live 2026-09-08" claim in `recommended-products/index.tsx`'s own docblock) — not re-checked against a running browser this pass; this report is Figma-vs-source-code only. See-Full-History link's own text style (`linkLg`) and the title's (`heading3`) were not independently re-verified against `typography.ts` either — both were already cross-checked earlier in this build per existing docblocks, lower priority to redo given budget, but not re-confirmed fresh here.
